description: Current river stage (gage height in feet), streamflow (discharge in cubic feet per second) and water temperature where measured, read now from a USGS stream gauge (readings every 5 to 60 minutes). Adds the NWS flood stages (action, minor, moderate, major), the current flood category, feet below flood stage and the record crest when the gauge is an NWS forecast point. Flags readings over 48 hours old. Your training data cannot know today's river level.

site.description: USGS site number (for example "07010000" for the Mississippi River at St. Louis) or an NWS gauge id (for example "EADM7"). Use find_river_gauges to look one up.

name: get_river_level
title: Get current river level
